title: The Missing Mascot
scene: At halftime, 7:45 PM, the stadium mascot head vanished. The tunnel was chained from 7:30 to 8:00.

suspects.name: Bruno Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in the tunnel at 7:45, changing into the costume.
suspects.contradiction: The tunnel chain was locked at 7:30, and feather trim was on Bruno's jacket.

suspects.name: Anita Cole
suspects.testimony: I was with the squad on the field at 7:45.
suspects.alibiProof: The field camera shows Anita at 7:43 and 7:48.

suspects.name: Dario Vale
suspects.testimony: I was selling drinks at the concession at 7:45.
suspects.alibiProof: The concession till shows Dario's sale at 7:44.

suspects.name: Nia Reed
suspects.testimony: I was at the mic booth at 7:45.
suspects.alibiProof: The booth log shows Nia's voice at 7:44 and 7:49.
